easyPrerequisites: You can cause a land to enter under your control this turn.
description:
Give Hexhaven Invigorator indestructible.
Cause a land to enter under your control.
When the land enters, Akoum Hellkite triggers, dealing damage to Hexhaven Invigorator.
Hexhaven Invigorator triggers, searching your library for a land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
Repeat from step 3
